features.name: Liminal Savant
features.description: Beginning at 2nd level, the gold and time you must spend to copy a liminal spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Mulligan
features.description:
At 2nd level, when a creature within 30 ft misses with an attack, use your reaction to let it reroll. When a creature within 30 ft hits with an attack (before damage), use your reaction to force a reroll using the lower result. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

At 10th level, you can also use this feature when a creature makes an ability check or saving throw.

payload.name: Mulligan
payload.description: When a creature within 30 ft misses an attack: let it reroll. When it hits before damage: force a reroll and use the lower result.

features.name: Otherworldly Sense
features.description: At 6th level, spend 1 minute meditating to sense one creature type (aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead) within 1 mile for 10 minutes. You know their general direction. Use an action to switch type. Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

features.name: Liminal Adept
features.description: At 10th level, add *threshold slip* to your spellbook. You can cast it without a slot (bring up to 2 willing creatures of your size or smaller touching you). 2 uses; regain all on short or long rest. At 14th level: 3 uses.

features.name: Forced Transition
features.description:
At 14th level, as an action, touch a willing creature or make a melee spell attack vs an unwilling one. Choose one effect lasting 1 minute:

**Rapid Advancement.** Each ability score +2 (max 24).
**Regression.** Each ability score -2 (min 1).
**True Self.** Target can't change shape (spells, traits); immediately reverts to true form. No effect on illusions.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Forced Transition
payload.description: Touch willing or melee spell attack vs unwilling: Rapid Advancement (+2 all scores, max 24), Regression (-2 all scores, min 1), or True Self (can't shapechange, reverts form). 1 min.
